startLead: Upload your presentation to prepare the slides. Related materials appear as they are found.

evidencePreparingQuietly: Looking for materials related to this slide.
evidencePrepared: Related materials found so far are shown here.

reportPending: The presentation results are being compiled.

coResidentDisabled: Move the presenter view to another device
